Hey guys! I have a situation where I want to display the search query in the currentRefinedValues widget, but at the same time I want to whitelist the other attributes that are listed (using  `onlyListedAttributes: true`). When this is enabled, the query doesn't show up even if `clearsQuery` is set to true.

Any way to display the query when `onlyListedAttributes` is enabled?

Sorry, can you make a new issue and a codesandbox describing this behaviour please @stianmartinsen . I don't think I understand it without context like this. Thanks!

There's a template here: https://codesandbox.io/s/x3q0p0vnko

title: fix(clear-all): display the query when clearQuery is true
